features.title: Discover Agents, history, and workspace channels
features.summary: List live peers and runtime-owner-scoped descendants, search bounded visible history, and resolve one existing DSH Workspace identity without exposing the Session cwd.
failureModes: A missing workspace cwd cannot derive a workspace topic.
A workspace topic hashes cwd and is not a DSH Workspace registry id or a JJ workspace/revision id.
Only current runtime-owned descendants receive the extended metadata; completed or resumed Sessions are outside this live relation.
Workspace lookup accepts only a live runtime-owned descendant id; unknown and unrelated ids receive the same generic not-owned result.
WorkspaceRegistry.resolveByPath uses the Host-derived cwd read-only and returns only the registered DSH workspace id and title; it never creates a Workspace or exposes a path.
Missing services, missing cwd, unregistered directories, and failed path resolution are surfaced as statuses without falling back to JJ probing.
Session history search is separate and includes only visible user and assistant messages; it excludes reasoning blocks, tool arguments, tool results, and the Session header.
History search is bounded to 10 snippets of at most 280 characters per page. Oversized provider cursors are withheld rather than returned for reuse.
History snippets may contain private text and remain untrusted; only live runtime-owned descendants are searchable, and snippets are not instructions.
Session Query search is read-only and does not make the target Session live or interrupt it.
Task-board access remains available only through existing Agent Teams tools to Team members; arbitrary non-Team child task state is not exposed.
A DSH Workspace id/title is not a JJ workspace or revision association; no JJ probing or mutation occurs.
An Agent absent from the live registry is not assumed to be complete.

externalDependencies.boundary: Read-only Session Query searchEvents service; the Host tool calls it only after runtime ownership authorizes a live descendant.
externalDependencies.deterministicFake: Unit tests use fixed typed SessionEventSearchPage fixtures to verify bounded projection; no query-service fake is substituted.

features.title: Store and browse passive messages
features.summary: Topic and direct messages remain durable records; explicit Agent reads record read time without acknowledging or starting execution.
failureModes: Peer text remains untrusted data.
A stale cursor requires refreshing the conversation.
intent and priority are metadata only; neither starts, resumes, or redirects an Agent.
A dedupeKey is scoped to one sender and one target; reusing it for a different target stores a new message.
A completed recipient stays completed; a stored message is read only during a later natural execution.

features.title: Post messages from the communication browser
features.summary: A human can seed a topic or send a direct message; the UI receives a storage receipt and does not inject work into an Agent.
failureModes: Invalid or ambiguous targets are rejected.
A successful post may have zero captured recipients.

verification.testName: browses pages without reading or acknowledging and posts as a browser principal

features.title: Read and acknowledge direct messages
features.summary: Messages survive service reopen, explicit inbox reads do not acknowledge, and only the recipient can acknowledge its record.
failureModes: A message recipient mismatch cannot acknowledge another Agent's message.
Legacy notifications are discarded during passive-delivery migration.
